label: append-mode-event.cjs is a TSX bootstrap that re-executes itself as a child process with --import tsx because every module it needs is a .ts source, so one append costs two node processes before ledger work starts.
The gateway's dynamic import graph is 79 modules and 1.09 MB of TypeScript loaded through tsx, and the deep-loop runtime has no dist directory at all, so there is no compiled fallback.

label: singleWriterReadCache is a per-process memo of one verified scan: a hit returns the memoized head without re-taking the lock, a miss scans and memoizes, and every append nulls the memo because the append changed the verified head.
The gateway never enables the cache and enabling it there would not help, because one invocation is one process performing one append and the append is what invalidates the memo.
sources: measured: grep singleWriterReadCache over scripts/append-mode-event.cjs and lib/mode-append-gateway -> no matches

label: The cache is already adopted where it pays: fanout-effect-dispatch.ts constructs its ledger with singleWriterReadCache true, and ledger-read-cache.vitest.ts already asserts the domain read lock is taken once rather than per read.

The gateway path is tens of spawns rather than hundreds: 13 test files reference append-mode-event with at most four references each, and each of those spawns pays the double process and the 79-module load.
